        f.id AS base_id,
        f.department_code,
        SUM(f.metric_val) AS metric_val,
        COALESCE(d.id, NULL) AS crm_deal_opportunities_enterprise_id,

        COALESCE(pr.id, NULL) AS crm_partner_referrals_inbound_id

        public.crm_deal_opportunities_enterprise d ON f.id = d.base_id

        public.crm_pipeline_stages_active ps ON f.id = ps.base_id
    LEFT JOIN 
        public.crm_support_cases_escalated sc ON f.id = sc.base_id
    LEFT JOIN 
        public.crm_partner_referrals_inbound pr ON f.id = pr.base_id
    WHERE 
        f.metric_val IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY 
        f.id, f.department_code
)
